title: I will build a custom Node.js automation or web scraping tool
description:
Got a repetitive job, a messy data source, or a tool you wish existed? I build it as a clean, working Node.js tool you can actually run.

Under the hood I'm used to large, many-part systems. What you get is the opposite: one simple tool that does the one thing you asked for, with plain instructions.

What I can build:
- Web scrapers that collect data into CSV or JSON
- Automation scripts for repetitive file, data and browser tasks
- Small desktop tools in Electron
- Fixes and cleanup for an existing Node.js script

How it works: you tell me what the finished result should do and how you'll check it. I build to that, show you it working, and hand over the code with a short readme.

A complex system in a simple form.

basic.name: Single Task Script
basic.description: One script that does one task, with run instructions.

standard.name: Scraper or Automation
standard.description: Scraper or automation with an output file and a readme.

premium.name: Desktop Tool or Multi-Step Flow
premium.description: Small Electron tool or multi-step automation, tested and documented.

faq.question: What do you need from me?
faq.answer: What the finished result should do, an example of the data or page, and how you will know it is right.

faq.question: Do you scrape any site?
faq.answer: Only where the site's terms allow it. I will tell you up front if I cannot.

faq.question: Will I get the source code?
faq.answer: Yes, with a short readme on how to run it.

requirements: What must the finished tool do or produce? Describe the end result in your own words.
Who will run it, and on what? (Windows, Mac, a server; one person or a team)
What must it always do, and what must it never do?
How will you check that it is done? (the test you will run, or what you will look at)
Please share any example pages, files, logins or data I need to build it.
